forces.title: Growing global wellness economy boosts nutraceuticals demand
forces.description: The global wellness economy is projected to expand at approximately 8% annually through 2030, outpacing many discretionary categories. This robust growth creates powerful tailwinds for products and services supporting healthier lifestyles, including dietary supplements, nutraceuticals, and functional foods as consumers broaden their wellness spending and reallocate budgets towards health.
forces.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

forces.title: Surging consumer spending on nutrition supplements drives market growth
forces.description: Consumers are actively reallocating personal budgets towards health and wellness, with nutrition supplements seeing the biggest jump (43%) in net spending in the Asia-Pacific region over the past 12 months. This substantial increase in a key category of Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals indicates a strong and accelerating global consumer demand, driven by heightened health awareness and proactive preventive care.

forces.title: Holistic consumer definition of wellness drives broader product investment
forces.description: Consumers are expanding their definition of fitness beyond exercise to encompass overall wellbeing, including cardiovascular health, weight management, longevity, and mental health. This holistic view influences spending across a broader set of wellness categories, creating opportunities for functional foods, nutraceuticals, and related products that address these diverse and evolving consumer needs, transforming market demand dynamics.
forces.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

forces.title: Strategic focus on metabolic health offers significant economic uplift
forces.description: Improving metabolic and cardiometabolic health at scale is identified as a powerful lever for enhancing health span, with the potential to generate up to $5.65 trillion in annual global GDP uplift by 2050. This focus drives demand for preventative solutions, dietary interventions, and nutraceuticals aimed at chronic disease prevention and healthy aging, creating substantial new market opportunities for IN060702.

forces.title: AI and digital tools empower personalized health and wellness behaviors
forces.description: Digital tools, wearables, and virtual companions, increasingly powered by AI, offer new ways for individuals to sustain healthier behaviors. These technologies can deliver personalized health insights, guidance, and content, enhancing consumer engagement with wellness products and services within IN060702, and supporting better health outcomes. This digital transformation reshapes how consumers interact with health management.

forces.title: UK consumer behavior shifting significantly towards health and wellness
forces.description: Deloitte UK highlights 'health and wellness' as a significant shift in UK consumer behavior for 2026. This trend necessitates that consumer businesses adapt their product and service portfolios to align with evolving needs. This directly benefits the Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals sector in the UK, signaling increased domestic demand and a need for innovative offerings tailored to health-conscious consumers.
forces.source_title: Retail and Consumer Trends 2026: Human-led intelligence

forces.title: London healthcare sector embraces longevity and preventative wellness
forces.description: London's private healthcare market is expanding its offerings beyond acute care to integrate preventative screening, executive health checks, genomics-informed risk assessments, and lifestyle medicine. This trend, driven by high-net-worth individuals and corporate clients, indicates a sophisticated and growing market for advanced wellness and longevity solutions, creating a strong demand signal for the Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals sector in the UK.
forces.source_title: The rising American interest in London’s healthcare market

forces.title: Retail pharmacy margin pressure from rising GLP-1 drug adoption
forces.description: The increasing interest in high-priced branded drugs, particularly GLP-1s, is compressing retail pharmacy margins. Traditionally, pharmacies relied on cross-subsidization from generic drugs, but plateauing generic dispensing rates, coupled with branded drug growth, mean margins could be further squeezed. This dynamic could impact the distribution, pricing, and profitability of Fast Moving Consumer Health (FMCH) products sold through pharmacy channels.
forces.source_title: The revival of pharmacy: The rise of cost-based reimbursement

forces.title: AI-driven product discovery mitigates consumer decision fatigue
forces.description: Consumers are overwhelmed by product choices and increasingly seek trusted guidance rather than just more information. AI is becoming influential in product discovery by addressing holistic questions about health goals. This creates an opportunity for Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals brands to leverage AI to provide personalized recommendations and advice, enhancing visibility, building trust, and driving adoption amidst product choice fatigue.
forces.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

forces.title: Blurring traditional category definitions creates cross-category growth opportunities
forces.description: Consumers are increasingly making purchasing decisions based on emotional triggers or specific need states, rather than rigid product categories, blurring traditional distinctions in consumer packaged goods. For FMCH products within IN060702, this shift creates significant opportunities to innovate and extend product lines beyond conventional boundaries, leveraging brand credibility to meet evolving, holistic consumer needs and achieve scale across connected categories.
forces.source_title: Freshening up: A new winning formula for home and hygiene players

viewpoints.title: Global wellness economy growth provides tailwinds for activewear and adjacencies
viewpoints.description: The global wellness economy is projected to expand at approximately 8% annually through 2030, outstripping many discretionary categories. This robust growth creates significant tailwinds for athletic apparel and footwear brands, and by extension, adjacent wellness sectors like nutrition and weight loss solutions. As consumers increasingly invest across a wider range of wellness categories, brands have a clear opportunity to capitalize on this expanding market.
viewpoints.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

viewpoints.title: Nutrition supplements show largest spending increase among Asia-Pacific consumers
viewpoints.description: Consumer health spending patterns in Asia-Pacific reveal a decisive shift towards health and wellness, with nutrition supplements experiencing the biggest jump in net spending at 43% over the prior 12 months. This substantial increase highlights a strong and accelerating consumer demand for products central to the Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals sector, signaling a positive global trend driven by enhanced health awareness and preventive care.

viewpoints.title: Improving metabolic health globally can unlock substantial economic and health benefits
viewpoints.description: McKinsey Health Institute estimates that large-scale improvements in metabolic and cardiometabolic health could yield health benefits three to four times greater than a treatment-only focus on obesity, potentially generating up to $5.65 trillion in annual global GDP uplift by 2050. This underscores the immense value and opportunity for the Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals sector in addressing preventative health and healthy aging.

viewpoints.title: UK consumer behavior shifts towards health and wellness, demanding adaptable brands
viewpoints.description: Deloitte UK identifies health and wellness as a key shift in consumer behavior for 2026, creating a need for businesses to 'right-size' their product and service portfolios for profitable growth. This trend requires responsiveness to evolving consumer needs, indicating a strong domestic tailwind for the Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals sector as brands must adapt to meet the increasing demand for related offerings.
viewpoints.source_title: Retail and Consumer Trends 2026: Human-led intelligence

viewpoints.title: London healthcare sector expands into longevity and preventative wellness offerings
viewpoints.description: London's private healthcare providers are responding to a growing public and high-net-worth individual interest in longevity and preventative wellness. They are expanding services beyond acute care to include preventative screening, executive health checks, and lifestyle medicine. This trend signifies a strategic shift in a key UK market towards comprehensive wellness, providing a strong growth environment for complementary nutraceuticals and wellness products.
viewpoints.source_title: The rising American interest in London’s healthcare market

viewpoints.title: AI-enabled healthcare tools boost consumer satisfaction and industry trust
viewpoints.description: Consumers engaging with AI-powered healthcare tools show higher satisfaction with the industry (54% exceeding expectations) compared to non-users (30%). This indicates AI's potential to improve personalized experiences, from understanding health needs to managing chronic conditions. For Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals, this suggests AI can enhance consumer engagement, build trust, and drive adoption of healthier behaviors supported by digital wellness solutions.
viewpoints.source_title: Healing consumer confidence through AI-powered, human-centered healthcare

viewpoints.title: Obesity and metabolic disease emerge as defining growth engines for European pharma
viewpoints.description: Obesity is identified as a defining near-term growth engine for the global pharma sector, particularly in Europe, driven by GLP-1s and catalyzing broader moves into metabolic disease and longevity spaces. While GLP-1s are pharmaceuticals, this trend highlights a significant market focus on health outcomes also targeted by nutraceuticals and functional foods, creating an environment of either competitive pressure or complementary growth for the Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals sector.
viewpoints.source_title: Accelerating Growth and Innovation in European Mid-Sized Pharma
